curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the nine basic shapes: octagon, triangle, diamond, pentagon, pennant, rectangles, round sign and crossbuck.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per shape; contrast cards for pennant versus diamond and the two railroad shapes.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz matching shapes to meanings.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach each sign color and what it signals, plus how regulatory signs look.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per color; contrast cards for the caution colors and the information colors.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz matching colors to meanings.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach route markers, destination and service signs, incident signs, and parking signs.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per guide or information sign.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on guide and information signs.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach what stop and yield signs require, their advance warnings, turn restrictions, lane-use, one-way and speed limit signs.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per regulatory sign; contrast card for the advance warning signs.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on stop, yield and turn signs.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach Keep Left, obstacle signs, Do Not Enter, Wrong Way, emergency crossovers and No Trucks.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per prohibition; contrast cards for Wrong Way versus Do Not Enter and Keep Left versus obstacles.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach Do Not Pass and Pass With Care, the no-passing pennant, railroad advance signs and the slow-moving vehicle triangle.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Passing and slow vehicle cards; contrast cards for the passing sign pair.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on passing zones and slow vehicles.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach curve, intersection, hill, slippery, bridge ice, clearance, exit speed, school, bicyclist, pedestrian and road work warnings.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per warning sign; contrast cards for the curve signs and the road surface signs.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach merging and lane-ending signs, divided highway ends, and the basics of white and yellow pavement markings.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Merge and marking cards; contrast cards for merging traffic versus lane ends.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on lane changes and markings.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec10-m01..sec10-m08; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact
